lineage.description: Building footprints were automatically detected using AI algorithms applied to Bing Maps satellite imagery (2016-2019) covering southern Guatemala. The methodology leverages machine learning for feature extraction from optical satellite data to generate vector building geometries. The dataset was produced to support disaster risk assessment for hurricanes Eta and Iota in Guatemala.
